Team —

Quick note to get us locked for today's submission window. We have a short 15-minute rapid review at 11:30am PT to triage late-stage changes and confirm commit signals before I push the submission. Please read and action the checklist below before the call.

Pre-flight checklist (do before 11:15am PT):
1) Update stage & expected close date in CRM for any deal that moved in the last 48 hours.
2) Add one-line reason for movement in the notes field (e.g., 'PO received — legal review', 'pricing hold', 'procurement kickoff').
3) Attach minimal evidence to deals >$50k in the Evidence section (quote, SOW, PO stub).
4) Flag any deals you're unsure about with tag: NEEDS-REVIEW.

Agenda for 11:30am rapid review (15m):
- 11:30–11:33: Quick roll call & top 3 risk accounts (owner calls out status)
- 11:33–11:40: Commit decisions (ON/OFF/NET), callouts for credit/discount asks
- 11:40: Submission window close — I will push final numbers to the finance queue

Attachments: pipeline_snapshot_May25.xlsx (filtered to your lanes), evidence_roster_May25.pdf
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-weekly-forecast-15m
HubSpot ref: HS-789123

If you can't make the 11:30 slot, reply with your commit decision and any new evidence; otherwise assume you'll be at the rapid review.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Director, Revenue Operations
